name: Differentiable DRR Generation via Vectorized GPU Siddon's Method
aliases: Auto-differentiable DRR Generation via Vectorized GPU Siddon's Method
Vectorized Siddon's Method for DRR Generation
definition: A method for generating Digitally Reconstructed Radiographs (DRRs) that are differentiable with respect to imaging parameters by implementing Siddon's ray-tracing algorithm as vectorized tensor operations within PyTorch.
